+/-- Concrete potentials on every original occurrence, including the root. -/
+abbrev Potential (n : ℕ) := Node n → ℝ
+
+/-- The original root occurrence. -/
+def rootNode (n : ℕ) : Node n := ⟨[], FiniteSourceMass.root_mem n⟩
+
+/-- Concrete functions in the actual uniform node Hilbert space. -/
+def nodeLp (n : ℕ) (f : Potential n) : NodeL2 n :=
+  (MemLp.of_discrete : MemLp f 2 (μ n)).toLp f
+
+private theorem edge_vertex (n : ℕ) (p : Edge) (hp : p ∈ edges n) :
+    p.val ∈ vertices n := by
+  simpa [edges] using hp
+
+/-- The reached child of an original unit-conductance edge. -/
+def child (n : ℕ) (p : Edge) (hp : p ∈ edges n) : Node n :=
+  ⟨p.val, edge_vertex n p hp⟩
+
+/-- The reached parent, with no additional edge incident to the root. -/
+def parent (n : ℕ) (p : Edge) (hp : p ∈ edges n) : Node n :=
+  ⟨p.val.dropLast, FiniteSourceCovariance.prefix_vertex n _ (child n p hp)
+    p.val.dropLast_prefix⟩
+
+/-- Parent-minus-child increments, zero on every absent common coordinate. -/
+def gradient (n : ℕ) (f : Potential n) : H :=
+  ∑ p ∈ edges n, lp.single 2 p
+    (if hp : p ∈ edges n then f (parent n p hp) - f (child n p hp) else 0)
+
+/-- Actual finite support in the fixed common edge space. -/
+def Supported (n : ℕ) (z : H) : Prop := ∀ p, p ∉ edges n → z p = 0
+
+private theorem gradient_apply (n : ℕ) (f : Potential n) (p : Edge) :
+    gradient n f p =
+      if hp : p ∈ edges n then f (parent n p hp) - f (child n p hp) else 0 := by
+  classical
+  change (lp.evalCLM ℝ (fun _ : Edge => ℝ) 2 p)
+    (∑ q ∈ edges n, lp.single 2 q
+      (if hq : q ∈ edges n then f (parent n q hq) - f (child n q hq) else 0)) = _
+  rw [map_sum]
+  change (∑ q ∈ edges n, (lp.single 2 q
+    (if hq : q ∈ edges n then f (parent n q hq) - f (child n q hq) else 0)) p) = _
+  by_cases hp : p ∈ edges n <;> simp [Pi.single_apply, eq_comm, hp]
+
+private theorem gradient_supported (n : ℕ) (f : Potential n) :
+    Supported n (gradient n f) := by
+  intro p hp
+  simp [gradient_apply, hp]
+
+private theorem prefix_snoc (q s : Address) (b : Bool) :
+    q.IsPrefix (s ++ [b]) ↔ q = s ++ [b] ∨ q.IsPrefix s := by
+  constructor
+  · intro h
+    by_cases hlen : q.length ≤ s.length
+    · right
+      rw [List.prefix_iff_eq_take] at h ⊢
+      simpa [List.take_append_of_le_length hlen] using h
+    · left
+      have he : q.length = (s ++ [b]).length := by
+        have := h.length_le
+        simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at *
+        omega
+      have ht := List.prefix_iff_eq_take.mp h
+      rw [he, List.take_length] at ht
+      exact ht
+  · rintro (rfl | h)
+    · exact List.prefix_refl _
+    · exact h.trans (List.prefix_append _ _)
+
+private theorem path_snoc (n : ℕ) (s : Address) (b : Bool)
+    (hx : s ++ [b] ∈ vertices n) :
+    path n 0 ⟨s ++ [b], hx⟩ =
+      insert (⟨s ++ [b], by simp⟩ : Edge)
+        (path n 0 ⟨s, FiniteSourceCovariance.prefix_vertex n s
+          ⟨s ++ [b], hx⟩ (List.prefix_append _ _)⟩) := by
+  classical
+  ext q
+  have hq : 0 < q.val.length := List.length_pos_of_ne_nil q.property
+  simp only [path, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_insert, hq, true_and,
+    prefix_snoc, Subtype.ext_iff]
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨hqE, h | h⟩
+    · exact Or.inl h
+    · exact Or.inr ⟨hqE, h⟩
+  · rintro (h | ⟨hqE, h⟩)
+    · exact ⟨by simpa [edges, h] using hx, Or.inl h⟩
+    · exact ⟨hqE, Or.inr h⟩
+
+private theorem value_snoc (n : ℕ) (s : Address) (b : Bool)
+    (hx : s ++ [b] ∈ vertices n) (z : H) :
+    value n 0 z ⟨s ++ [b], hx⟩ =
+      value n 0 z ⟨s, FiniteSourceCovariance.prefix_vertex n s
+        ⟨s ++ [b], hx⟩ (List.prefix_append _ _)⟩ + z ⟨s ++ [b], by simp⟩ := by
+  classical
+  have hnot : (⟨s ++ [b], by simp⟩ : Edge) ∉ path n 0
+      ⟨s, FiniteSourceCovariance.prefix_vertex n s
+        ⟨s ++ [b], hx⟩ (List.prefix_append _ _)⟩ := by
+    intro h
+    have hlen := (Finset.mem_filter.mp h).2.2.length_le
+    simp at hlen
+  unfold value
+  rw [path_snoc, Finset.sum_insert hnot, add_comm]
+
+private theorem value_root (n : ℕ) (z : H) : value n 0 z (rootNode n) = 0 := by
+  classical
+  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
+  intro p hp
+  have h := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2.2
+  have : p.val = [] := List.prefix_nil.mp h
+  exact False.elim (p.property this)
+
+private theorem value_parent (n : ℕ) (p : Edge) (hp : p ∈ edges n) (z : H) :
+    value n 0 z (child n p hp) = value n 0 z (parent n p hp) + z p := by
+  obtain ⟨s, b, he⟩ : ∃ s b, p.val = s ++ [b] := by
+    exact ⟨p.val.dropLast, p.val.getLast p.property,
+      (List.dropLast_append_getLast p.property).symm⟩
+  have hv := value_snoc n s b (he ▸ edge_vertex n p hp) z
+  have ep : (⟨s ++ [b], by simp⟩ : Edge) = p := Subtype.ext he.symm
+  simpa [child, parent, he, ep] using hv
+
+private theorem path_gradient (n : ℕ) (f : Potential n) (x : Node n) :
+    value n 0 (gradient n f) x = f (rootNode n) - f x := by
+  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
+  induction x using List.reverseRecOn with
+  | nil => simpa [rootNode] using value_root n (gradient n f)
+  | append_singleton s b ih =>
+    have hs := FiniteSourceCovariance.prefix_vertex n s ⟨s ++ [b], hx⟩
+      (List.prefix_append _ _)
+    have hp : (⟨s ++ [b], by simp⟩ : Edge) ∈ edges n := by simpa [edges] using hx
+    rw [value_snoc, ih hs, gradient_apply, dif_pos hp]
+    simp only [parent, child, List.dropLast_concat]
+    ring

+/-- The root value minus the actual root-to-node path sum. -/
+def reconstruct (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (z : H) : Potential n :=
+  fun x => c - value n 0 z x
+
+private theorem gradient_reconstruct (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (z : H)
+    (hz : Supported n z) : gradient n (reconstruct n c z) = z := by
+  ext p
+  rw [gradient_apply]
+  split_ifs with hp
+  · dsimp [reconstruct]
+    rw [value_parent]
+    ring
+  · exact (hz p hp).symm
+
+private theorem inner_gradient (n : ℕ) (f : Potential n) (z : H) :
+    inner ℝ (gradient n f) z =
+      ∑ p ∈ edges n,
+        (if hp : p ∈ edges n then f (parent n p hp) - f (child n p hp) else 0) * z p := by
+  classical
+  simp [gradient, sum_inner, lp.inner_single_left, mul_comm]
+
+/-- The original counting Laplacian: each reached parent-child edge occurs once. -/
+def countingLaplacian (n : ℕ) (f : Potential n) : Potential n := fun x =>
+  ∑ p ∈ edges n, if hp : p ∈ edges n then
+    (f (parent n p hp) - f (child n p hp)) *
+      ((if x = parent n p hp then 1 else 0) - (if x = child n p hp then 1 else 0))
+    else 0
+
+private theorem counting_energy (n : ℕ) (f g : Potential n) :
+    (∑ x, f x * countingLaplacian n g x) =
+      inner ℝ (gradient n f) (gradient n g) := by
+  classical
+  simp only [countingLaplacian, Finset.mul_sum]
+  rw [Finset.sum_comm, inner_gradient]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro p hp
+  simp only [dif_pos hp, gradient_apply]
+  simp only [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
+  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
+  ring
+
+private theorem nodeLp_inner (n : ℕ) (f g : Potential n) :
+    inner ℝ (nodeLp n f) (nodeLp n g) =
+      (N n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ x, f x * g x := by
+  rw [L2.inner_def]
+  have he : (fun x => inner ℝ (nodeLp n f x) (nodeLp n g x)) =ᵐ[μ n]
+      (fun x => f x * g x) := by
+    filter_upwards [(MemLp.of_discrete : MemLp f 2 (μ n)).coeFn_toLp,
+      (MemLp.of_discrete : MemLp g 2 (μ n)).coeFn_toLp] with x hf hg
+    have hf' : nodeLp n f x = f x := hf
+    have hg' : nodeLp n g x = g x := hg
+    simp [hf', hg', mul_comm]
+  rw [integral_congr_ae he, integral_fintype Integrable.of_finite]
+  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro x _
+  rw [measureReal_def, FiniteSourceMass.finite_source_masses.2.2.2.2.2.1]
+  simp
+
+private theorem nodeLp_reconstruct (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (z : H) :
+    nodeLp n (reconstruct n c z) = c • one n - FiniteSourceHardy.J n z := by
+  unfold nodeLp
+  change _ = c • one n - FiniteSourceHardy.trace n 0 z
+  unfold one FiniteSourceHardy.trace
+  rw [← MemLp.toLp_const_smul, ← MemLp.toLp_sub]
+  apply MemLp.toLp_congr
+  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by simp [reconstruct]
+
+/-- Actual path reconstruction and unit-edge energy with the uniform/counting factor.
+This applies to every source index, including both edge-free singleton sources. -/
+theorem actual_reconstruction_energy (n : ℕ) :
+    (∀ f : Potential n,
+      reconstruct n (f (rootNode n)) (gradient n f) = f) ∧
+    (∀ (c : ℝ) (z : H), Supported n z →
+      gradient n (reconstruct n c z) = z) ∧
+    (∀ f g : Potential n,
+      (N n : ℝ) * inner ℝ (nodeLp n f) (nodeLp n (countingLaplacian n g)) =
+        inner ℝ (gradient n f) (gradient n g)) ∧
+    (∀ (c : ℝ) (z : H),
+      nodeLp n (reconstruct n c z) = c • one n - FiniteSourceHardy.J n z) := by
+  refine ⟨?_, gradient_reconstruct n, ?_, nodeLp_reconstruct n⟩
+  · intro f
+    funext x
+    dsimp [reconstruct]
+    rw [path_gradient]
+    ring
+  · intro f g
+    rw [nodeLp_inner, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (by
+      exact_mod_cast (FiniteSourceMass.N_pos n).ne'), one_mul, counting_energy]
+
+private def nodeLinear (n : ℕ) : Potential n →ₗ[ℝ] NodeL2 n where
+  toFun := nodeLp n
+  map_add' f g := by
+    unfold nodeLp
+    rw [← MemLp.toLp_add]
+  map_smul' c f := by
+    unfold nodeLp
+    rw [← MemLp.toLp_const_smul]
+    rfl
+
+private theorem nodeLinear_bijective (n : ℕ) : Function.Bijective (nodeLinear n) := by
+  classical
+  constructor
+  · intro f g h
+    funext x
+    have he := congrArg (fun u : NodeL2 n =>
+      inner ℝ u (nodeLp n (fun y => if y = x then 1 else 0))) h
+    change inner ℝ (nodeLp n f) _ = inner ℝ (nodeLp n g) _ at he
+    simp only [nodeLp_inner] at he
+    simp only [mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ,
+      ite_true] at he
+    exact mul_left_cancel₀ (inv_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast (FiniteSourceMass.N_pos n).ne')) he
+  · intro f
+    refine ⟨fun x => f x, ?_⟩
+    exact Lp.toLp_coeFn f MemLp.of_discrete
+
+/-- The faithful uniform L2 representation of all concrete node functions. -/
+def nodeEquiv (n : ℕ) : Potential n ≃L[ℝ] NodeL2 n :=
+  (LinearEquiv.ofBijective (nodeLinear n) (nodeLinear_bijective n)).toContinuousLinearEquiv
+
+private def laplacianLinear (n : ℕ) : Potential n →ₗ[ℝ] Potential n where
+  toFun := countingLaplacian n
+  map_add' f g := by
+    classical
+    funext x
+    simp only [countingLaplacian, Pi.add_apply, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro p hp
+    simp only [dif_pos hp, RingHom.id_apply]
+    ring
+  map_smul' c f := by
+    classical
+    funext x
+    simp only [countingLaplacian, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro p hp
+    simp only [dif_pos hp, RingHom.id_apply]
+    ring
+
+/-- The actual counting Laplacian transported to the uniform node Hilbert space. -/
+def L (n : ℕ) : NodeL2 n →L[ℝ] NodeL2 n :=
+  (nodeEquiv n).toContinuousLinearMap.comp
+    ((laplacianLinear n).toContinuousLinearMap.comp (nodeEquiv n).symm.toContinuousLinearMap)
+
+/-- Actual root evaluation, without killing or a boundary condition at the root. -/
+def root (n : ℕ) : NodeL2 n →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
+  (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (rootNode n)).comp (nodeEquiv n).symm.toContinuousLinearMap
+
+/-- The counting root delta, represented in the uniform node space. -/
+def source (n : ℕ) : NodeL2 n :=
+  nodeLp n (fun x => if x = rootNode n then 1 else 0)
+
+private theorem L_nodeLp (n : ℕ) (f : Potential n) :
+    L n (nodeLp n f) = nodeLp n (countingLaplacian n f) := by
+  change nodeEquiv n (laplacianLinear n ((nodeEquiv n).symm (nodeEquiv n f))) = _
+  rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
+  rfl
+
+private theorem root_nodeLp (n : ℕ) (f : Potential n) :
+    root n (nodeLp n f) = f (rootNode n) := by
+  change ((nodeEquiv n).symm (nodeEquiv n f)) (rootNode n) = _
+  rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
+
+/-- The actual source has supported path coordinates and exact counting normalization. -/
+theorem actual_screening_bridge (n : ℕ) :
+    (∀ f : NodeL2 n, ∃ (c : ℝ) (z : H), Supported n z ∧
+      f = c • one n - FiniteSourceHardy.J n z) ∧
+    (∀ (c d : ℝ) (z w : H), Supported n z → Supported n w →
+      (N n : ℝ) * inner ℝ (c • one n - FiniteSourceHardy.J n z)
+        (L n (d • one n - FiniteSourceHardy.J n w)) = inner ℝ z w) ∧
+    (∀ (c : ℝ) (z : H), root n (c • one n - FiniteSourceHardy.J n z) = c) ∧
+    (∀ (c : ℝ) (z : H),
+      inner ℝ (source n) (c • one n - FiniteSourceHardy.J n z) = c / (N n : ℝ)) := by
+  have hr := actual_reconstruction_energy n
+  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · intro f
+    let g := (nodeEquiv n).symm f
+    refine ⟨g (rootNode n), gradient n g, gradient_supported n g, ?_⟩
+    rw [← hr.2.2.2, hr.1]
+    exact (nodeEquiv n).apply_symm_apply f |>.symm

+    rw [← hr.2.2.2 c z, ← hr.2.2.2 d w, L_nodeLp, hr.2.2.1,
+      hr.2.1 c z hz, hr.2.1 d w hw]
+  · intro c z
+    rw [← hr.2.2.2 c z, root_nodeLp]
+    simp [reconstruct, value_root]
+  · intro c z

+    unfold source
+    rw [nodeLp_inner]
+    simp [ite_mul, reconstruct, value_root, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

+noncomputable def unitInverse {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
+    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
+    (A : E →L[ℝ] E) (hA : IsUnit A) : E →L[ℝ] E := by
+  letI := hA.invertible

+private theorem L_positive (n : ℕ) (f : NodeL2 n) :
+    0 ≤ inner ℝ (L n f) f := by

+        real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
+      nlinarith
+    _ ≤ ‖inner ℝ ((L n + lam • (1 : NodeL2 n →L[ℝ] NodeL2 n)) f) f‖ := le_abs_self _

+private theorem covariance_pair (n : ℕ) (z w : H) :
+    inner ℝ z (Sigma n w) =

+        inner ℝ z (v n) * inner ℝ (v n) w := by
+  simp only [FiniteSourceCovariance.Sigma, B, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, inner_sub_right,
+    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right,
+    rankOne_apply, real_inner_smul_right]

+    0 ≤ inner ℝ (Sigma n z) z := by

+  have hs := (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg (inner ℝ (one n) (FiniteSourceHardy.J n z)))
+    (norm_nonneg (FiniteSourceHardy.J n z))).2 hab

+  nlinarith

+private theorem screened_unit (n : ℕ) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) :
+    IsUnit (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ H + ((N n : ℝ) * lam) • Sigma n) := by
+  apply ContinuousLinearMap.isUnit_of_forall_le_norm_inner_map
+    (𝕜 := ℝ) (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ H + ((N n : ℝ) * lam) • Sigma n)
+    (c := 1) (by norm_num)
+  intro z
+  have hp := Sigma_positive n z
+  have ht : 0 ≤ (N n : ℝ) * lam := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hlam.le
+  calc
+    ‖z‖ ^ 2 * (1 : ℝ≥0) ≤
+        inner ℝ ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ H + ((N n : ℝ) * lam) • Sigma n) z) z := by
+      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
+        ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left,
+        real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, NNReal.coe_one, mul_one]
+      exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg ht hp)
+    _ ≤ ‖inner ℝ ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ H + ((N n : ℝ) * lam) • Sigma n) z) z‖ :=

+/-- Original counting root response, using the proved positive resolvent inverse. -/

+private theorem inverse_apply (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E]
+    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
+    (A : E →L[ℝ] E) (hA : IsUnit A) (x : E) :
+    A (unitInverse A hA x) = x := by
+  letI := hA.invertible
+  change (A * ⅟A) x = x
+  rw [mul_invOf_self]
+  rfl

+  letI := hA.invertible

+  have hb : nodeLp n b = g := (nodeEquiv n).apply_symm_apply g

+  have he' := (actual_reconstruction_energy n).2.2.1 b a

+    exact_mod_cast (FiniteSourceMass.N_pos n).ne')

+        (N n : ℝ) * inner ℝ g (L n f) := by rw [real_inner_comm]
+    _ = inner ℝ (gradient n b) (gradient n a) := he'
+    _ = inner ℝ (gradient n a) (gradient n b) := real_inner_comm _ _
+    _ = (N n : ℝ) * inner ℝ f (L n g) := he.symm

+/-- The exact centered counting response for every original finite source. -/
+theorem finite_source_screening (n : ℕ) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) :

+  let τ : ℝ := (N n : ℝ) * lam
+  have hτ : τ ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast (FiniteSourceMass.N_pos n).ne') hlam.ne'
+  let z : H := screened_inverse n lam hlam (v n)
+  let c : ℝ := τ⁻¹ + inner ℝ (v n) z
+  let f : NodeL2 n := c • one n - FiniteSourceHardy.J n z
+  have hAz : z + τ • Sigma n z = v n := by
+    exact inverse_apply H _ (screened_unit n lam hlam) (v n)
+  have hτc : τ * c = 1 + τ * inner ℝ (v n) z := by
+    dsimp [c]
+    rw [mul_add, mul_inv_cancel₀ hτ]

+      z = v n - τ • Sigma n z := eq_sub_of_add_eq hAz
+      _ = τ • (FiniteSourceHardy.J n).adjoint f := by

+        simp only [map_sub, map_smul, FiniteSourceCovariance.Sigma,

+          (τ * c) • v n - τ • B n z
+        rw [hτc, add_smul, one_smul]
+        abel
+  have ho : inner ℝ (one n) (one n) = 1 := by
+    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, FiniteSourceCovariance.one_norm]
+    norm_num
+  have hmean : inner ℝ f (one n) = τ⁻¹ := by
+    rw [real_inner_comm]
+    dsimp [f]
+    rw [inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_right, ho, mul_one]
+    have hv : inner ℝ (one n) (FiniteSourceHardy.J n z) = inner ℝ (v n) z :=
+      (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left _ _ _).symm
+    rw [hv]
+    dsimp [c]
+    ring
+  have hweak (g : Potential n) :
+      (N n : ℝ) * inner ℝ f (L n (nodeLp n g)) +
+        τ * inner ℝ f (nodeLp n g) = g (rootNode n) := by
+    have hrec := (actual_reconstruction_energy n).1 g
+    have hdec : nodeLp n g =
+        g (rootNode n) • one n - FiniteSourceHardy.J n (gradient n g) := by
+      exact (congrArg (nodeLp n) hrec).symm.trans (nodeLp_reconstruct n _ _)
+    have he := reconstruction_energy n c z g
+    change (N n : ℝ) * inner ℝ f (L n (nodeLp n g)) = _ at he
+    have hedge : inner ℝ z (gradient n g) =
+        τ * inner ℝ f (FiniteSourceHardy.J n (gradient n g)) := by
+      rw [hz, real_inner_smul_left, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left]
+    rw [he, hdec, inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_right, hmean, hedge]
+    field_simp [hτ]
+    <;> ring
+  have hsol : (L n + lam • (1 : NodeL2 n →L[ℝ] NodeL2 n)) f = source n := by
+    apply ext_inner_right ℝ
+    intro u
+    let g := (nodeEquiv n).symm u
+    have hg : nodeLp n g = u := (nodeEquiv n).apply_symm_apply u
+    have hw := hweak g
+    rw [hg] at hw
+    have hs : (N n : ℝ) * inner ℝ (source n) u = g (rootNode n) := by
+      rw [← hg]
+      unfold source
+      rw [nodeLp_inner]
+      simp only [ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq',
+        Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
+      rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (by
+        exact_mod_cast (FiniteSourceMass.N_pos n).ne'), one_mul]
+    apply mul_left_cancel₀ (show (N n : ℝ) ≠ 0 by
+      exact_mod_cast (FiniteSourceMass.N_pos n).ne')
+    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
+      ContinuousLinearMap.one_apply, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left,
+      L_symmetric]
+    dsimp [τ] at hw
+    nlinarith [hs]
+  have hfinv : unitInverse (L n + lam • (1 : NodeL2 n →L[ℝ] NodeL2 n))
+      (laplacian_unit n lam hlam) (source n) = f := by
+    rw [← hsol]
+    exact inverse_cancel _ _ _ _
+  unfold root_response
+  rw [hfinv]
+  change root n (c • one n - FiniteSourceHardy.J n z) - 1 / τ = inner ℝ (v n) z
+  rw [(actual_screening_bridge n).2.2.1 c z]
+  dsimp [c]
+  rw [one_div]
+  ring
+
+end D5.S3.Arith.FibonacciAtomic.Geometry.FiniteSourceScreening

+import D5.S3.Arith.FibonacciAtomic.Observer.Constructor.NativePositiveBranchReduction
+import D5.S3.Combinatorics.Graph.LayeredCirculation.SupplierDual
+import D5.S3.Arith.FibonacciAtomic.Observer.Constructor.NativeComputedEpochPotential
+/-! Integer consistency and minimum natural ranks on the actual source graph. -/

+set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
+namespace D5.S3.Arith.FibonacciAtomic.Observer.NativePositivePotentialCover
+open NativePositiveBranchReduction NativePositiveImageCover NativeTermUnification
+open NativeGroundSolutionSpace Maths Maths.MaxPlusPotential
+open Lambda Strata.Util
+variable {X : Type} [DecidableEq X]
+/-- Select one residual sort without identifying repeated or parallel edges. -/
+def sortEdges (B : List (BranchEquation X)) (s : X → Term X) (j : X) :=
+  (sourceOffsetEdges B s).filter (fun e => e.1.1.2.2 == j)
+abbrev Edge (B : List (BranchEquation X)) (s : X → Term X) (j : X) :=
+  Fin (sortEdges B s j).length × Bool
+def signedGraph (B : List (BranchEquation X)) (s : X → Term X) (j : X) :
+    EdgeGraph (Occurrence X) (Edge B s j) where
+  source e := if e.2 then ((sortEdges B s j).get e.1).1.1
+    else ((sortEdges B s j).get e.1).1.2
+  target e := if e.2 then ((sortEdges B s j).get e.1).1.2
+    else ((sortEdges B s j).get e.1).1.1
+def signedWeight (B : List (BranchEquation X)) (s : X → Term X) (j : X)
+    (e : Edge B s j) : Int :=
+  if e.2 then -((sortEdges B s j).get e.1).2 else ((sortEdges B s j).get e.1).2
+def ZeroCycles (B : List (BranchEquation X)) (s : X → Term X) (j : X) : Prop :=
+  ∀ (v : Occurrence X) (c : (signedGraph B s j).Walk v v),
+    walkWeight (signedWeight B s j) c = 0
+def Potential (B : List (BranchEquation X)) (s : X → Term X) (j : X)
+    (δ : Occurrence X → Int) : Prop :=
+  ∀ e ∈ sortEdges B s j, δ e.1.1 = δ e.1.2 + e.2
+/-- The leaf carrier is arbitrary; nonemptiness is needed only to detect
+inconsistent cycles. No shape or rank bound is imposed. -/
+def BlockSolution (B : List (BranchEquation X)) (s : X → Term X) (j : X)
+    {L : Type} (u : Occurrence X → L → Nat) : Prop :=
+  ∀ e ∈ sortEdges B s j, ∀ l, (u e.1.1 l : Int) = (u e.1.2 l : Int) + e.2
+private theorem potential_iff (B : List (BranchEquation X)) (s : X → Term X) (j : X)
+    (δ : Occurrence X → Int) :
+    Potential B s j δ ↔ IsPotential (signedGraph B s j) (signedWeight B s j) δ := by
+  constructor
+  · intro h e
+    have eq := h _ (List.get_mem (sortEdges B s j) e.1)
+    cases e with | mk i b => cases b <;> simp_all [signedGraph, signedWeight] <;> omega
+  · intro h e he
+    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_get.mp he
+    have hf := h (i, false)
+    have hb := h (i, true)
+    simp only [signedGraph, signedWeight, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hf hb
+    omega
+private theorem walk_exact {B : List (BranchEquation X)} {s : X → Term X} {j : X}
+    {δ : Occurrence X → Int} (h : Potential B s j δ)
+    {v w : Occurrence X} (c : (signedGraph B s j).Walk v w) :
+    walkWeight (signedWeight B s j) c = δ w - δ v := by
+  induction c with
+  | nil => simp [walkWeight]
+  | concat c e legal ih =>
+      have eq := h _ (List.get_mem (sortEdges B s j) e.1)
+      rw [walkWeight_concat, ih]
+      subst legal
+      cases e with | mk i b => cases b <;> simp_all [signedGraph, signedWeight] <;> omega

+    ZeroCycles B s j ↔ ∃ δ, Potential B s j δ := by
+  constructor
+  · intro h
+    obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ :=
+      (exists_isPotential_iff_forall_closedWalk_nonpos
+        (G := signedGraph B s j) (signedWeight B s j)).mpr (fun v c => (h v c).le)
+    exact ⟨δ, (potential_iff B s j δ).mpr hδ⟩
+  · rintro ⟨δ, hδ⟩ v c
+    simpa using walk_exact hδ c
+/-- Enumerate the two signed orientations of every actual source edge.
+The list retains separate indices for repeated and parallel comparisons. -/
+def signedEdges (B : List (BranchEquation X)) (s : X → Term X) (j : X) :
+    List (Edge B s j) :=
+  (List.finRange (sortEdges B s j).length).flatMap fun i => [(i, false), (i, true)]
+private theorem signedEdges_complete (B : List (BranchEquation X))
+    (s : X → Term X) (j : X) (e : Edge B s j) : e ∈ signedEdges B s j := by

+  apply List.mem_flatMap.mpr
+  refine ⟨i, List.mem_finRange i, ?_⟩
+  cases b <;> simp
+/-- Finite max-plus relaxation on the original source occurrence graph.
+Zero is a lower bound at every vertex, including isolated occurrences. -/
+def sourceRelaxation (B : List (BranchEquation X)) (s : X → Term X) (j : X) :
+    Nat → Occurrence X → Int
+  | 0, _ => 0
+  | t + 1, v =>
+      ((signedEdges B s j).map fun e =>
+        if (signedGraph B s j).target e = v then
+          sourceRelaxation B s j t ((signedGraph B s j).source e) + signedWeight B s j e
+        else 0).foldr max 0

+rounds is the number of signed indexed source edges. -/
+def computedSourcePotential (B : List (BranchEquation X)) (s : X → Term X) (j : X) :
+    Occurrence X → Int :=
+  sourceRelaxation B s j (2 * (sortEdges B s j).length)
+private theorem sourceRelaxation_nonneg (B : List (BranchEquation X))

+  | zero => exact le_rfl
+  | succ t => exact NativeComputedEpochPotential.base_le_fold_max _ 0

+      sourceRelaxation B s j (t + 1) ((signedGraph B s j).target e) := by
+  apply List.le_max_of_le' (0 : Int)
+  · exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨e, signedEdges_complete B s j e, rfl⟩
+  · simp only [ite_true]
+    exact le_rfl

+          have hp := ih c (by simpa using Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hlen)
+          have he := sourceRelaxation_edge B s j t e
+          rw [legal] at he
+          rw [walkWeight_concat]

+private theorem sourceRelaxation_attained (B : List (BranchEquation X))
+    (s : X → Term X) (j : X) (t : Nat) (v : Occurrence X) :
+    ∃ (start : Occurrence X) (c : (signedGraph B s j).Walk start v),

+  induction t generalizing v with

+  | succ t ih =>

+      · exact ⟨v, .nil, Nat.zero_le _, by simp [walkWeight, EdgeGraph.Walk.edges]⟩

+          · rw [walkWeight_castFinish, walkWeight_concat, hvalue]
+        · simp only [if_neg he]
+          exact ⟨v, .nil, Nat.zero_le _, by simp [walkWeight, EdgeGraph.Walk.edges]⟩
+private theorem computed_source_potential (B : List (BranchEquation X))
+    (s : X → Term X) (j : X) (good : ZeroCycles B s j) :
+    Potential B s j (computedSourcePotential B s j) := by
+  apply (potential_iff B s j _).mpr
+  intro e
+  obtain ⟨start, c, _, hvalue⟩ := sourceRelaxation_attained B s j
+    (2 * (sortEdges B s j).length) ((signedGraph B s j).source e)
+  obtain ⟨pruned, hnodup, hweight⟩ := exists_nodup_visited_walkWeight_le

+  have hcard : pruned.length ≤ 2 * (sortEdges B s j).length := by
+    simpa only [EdgeGraph.Walk.edges_length, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin,
+      Fintype.card_bool, Nat.mul_comm] using

+  rw [walkWeight_concat] at hweight
+  change sourceRelaxation B s j _ ((signedGraph B s j).source e) + signedWeight B s j e ≤
+    sourceRelaxation B s j _ ((signedGraph B s j).target e)
+  omega
+/-- Check every original indexed source equation against the finite relaxation
+candidate. Empty edge lists are accepted, and no vertex or integer bound is
+assumed. All arithmetic and equality tests are executable. -/
+def checkSourceConsistency (B : List (BranchEquation X)) (s : X → Term X) (j : X) : Bool :=
+  (sortEdges B s j).all fun e => decide
+    (computedSourcePotential B s j e.1.1 = computedSourcePotential B s j e.1.2 + e.2)
+private theorem check_source_consistency_iff_potential
+    (B : List (BranchEquation X)) (s : X → Term X) (j : X) :
+    checkSourceConsistency B s j = true ↔ Potential B s j (computedSourcePotential B s j) := by
+  simp only [checkSourceConsistency, List.all_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, Potential]
+/-- The finite executable check is sound and complete for the original
+condition on all closed walks of the labelled signed source graph. -/
+theorem source_consistency_iff (B : List (BranchEquation X)) (s : X → Term X) (j : X) :
+    checkSourceConsistency B s j = true ↔ ZeroCycles B s j := by
+  rw [check_source_consistency_iff_potential]
+  constructor
+  · intro h
+    exact (zeroCycles_iff B s j).mpr ⟨computedSourcePotential B s j, h⟩
+  · exact computed_source_potential B s j
+/-- Return a certified computed potential precisely when the finite check
+accepts. The certificate is erased during execution; rejection returns none. -/
+def effectiveSourcePotential (B : List (BranchEquation X)) (s : X → Term X) (j : X) :
+    Option {δ : Occurrence X → Int // Potential B s j δ} :=
+  if h : checkSourceConsistency B s j = true then
+    some ⟨computedSourcePotential B s j,
+      (check_source_consistency_iff_potential B s j).mp h⟩
+  else none
+/-- Original shifts U=V+3, U=V+3, U=V+4 on their common residual sort. -/
+def parallelSourceInput : List (BranchEquation Bool) × (Bool → Term Bool) × Bool :=
+  ([.shift true 3 false, .shift true 3 false, .shift true 4 false],
+    (fun _ => .of (.inr false)), false)
+private theorem edge_spec (p : Presentation X) (B : List (BranchEquation X))
+    (S : SubstInfo)
+    (hok : (encodeEquations p (shapeEquations B)).unify SubstInfo.empty = .ok S)
+    {e : (Occurrence X × Occurrence X) × Int}
+    (he : e ∈ sourceOffsetEdges B (action p S)) :
+    e.1.1 ∈ occurrenceVertices p (action p S) ∧
+    e.1.2 ∈ occurrenceVertices p (action p S) ∧ e.1.1.2.2 = e.1.2.2.2 := by
+  apply (mgu_occurrence_graph_exact p (shapeEquations B) S hok).2.1
+  rw [← source_comparison_graph_identification]
+  exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨e, he, rfl⟩
+private theorem connected_sort (p : Presentation X) (B : List (BranchEquation X))
+    (S : SubstInfo)
+    (hok : (encodeEquations p (shapeEquations B)).unify SubstInfo.empty = .ok S)
+    {v w : Occurrence X} (h : sourceConnected B (action p S) v w) :
+    v.2.2 = w.2.2 := by
+  induction h with
+  | rel a b he =>
+      obtain ⟨e, he, eq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp he
+      have hs := (edge_spec p B S hok he).2.2
+      simpa only [eq] using hs
+  | refl => rfl
+  | symm _ _ _ ih => exact ih.symm
+  | trans _ _ _ _ _ ih1 ih2 => exact ih1.trans ih2
+private theorem common_difference (p : Presentation X) (B : List (BranchEquation X))
+    (S : SubstInfo)
+    (hok : (encodeEquations p (shapeEquations B)).unify SubstInfo.empty = .ok S)
+    (j : X) {f g : Occurrence X → Int}
+    (hf : Potential B (action p S) j f) (hg : Potential B (action p S) j g)
+    {v w : Occurrence X} (h : sourceConnected B (action p S) v w) :
+    v.2.2 = j → f v - g v = f w - g w := by
+  induction h with
+  | rel v w he =>
+      intro hv
+      obtain ⟨e, he, eq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp he
+      have pair : e.1 = (v,w) := eq
+      have mem : e ∈ sortEdges B (action p S) j := by
+        simp only [sortEdges, List.mem_filter, beq_iff_eq]
+        exact ⟨he, by simpa only [pair] using hv⟩
+      have h1 := hf e mem
+      have h2 := hg e mem
+      simp only [pair] at h1 h2
+      omega
+  | refl v => intro _; rfl
+  | symm v w h ih =>
+      intro hw
+      have hv : v.2.2 = j := (connected_sort p B S hok h).trans hw
+      exact (ih hv).symm
+  | trans v w z h1 h2 ih1 ih2 =>
+      intro hv
+      have hw : w.2.2 = j := (connected_sort p B S hok h1).symm.trans hv
+      exact (ih1 hv).trans (ih2 hw)
+/-- The actual source comparison graph admits one minimum natural base per
+occurring sort. Nonzero cycles exclude solutions on every inhabited leaf
+carrier; zero cycles classify all natural solutions, including a singleton
+isolated occurrence. The theorem does not assert native code reconstruction. -/
+theorem source_sort_minimum_base (p : Presentation X) (B : List (BranchEquation X))
+    (S : SubstInfo)
+    (hok : (encodeEquations p (shapeEquations B)).unify SubstInfo.empty = .ok S)
+    (j : X) (occurs : ∃ v ∈ occurrenceVertices p (action p S), v.2.2 = j) :
+    (¬ ZeroCycles B (action p S) j →
+      ∀ (L : Type) [Nonempty L] (u : Occurrence X → L → Nat),
+        ¬ BlockSolution B (action p S) j u) ∧
+    (ZeroCycles B (action p S) j →
+      ∃ (δ : Occurrence X → Int) (b : Occurrence X) (a : Occurrence X → Nat),
+        δ = computedSourcePotential B (action p S) j ∧
+        Potential B (action p S) j δ ∧
+        b ∈ occurrenceVertices p (action p S) ∧ b.2.2 = j ∧ a b = 0 ∧
+        (∀ v ∈ occurrenceVertices p (action p S), v.2.2 = j →
+          δ b ≤ δ v ∧ (a v : Int) = δ v - δ b) ∧
+        (∀ (L : Type) (u : Occurrence X → L → Nat),
+          BlockSolution B (action p S) j u ↔
+          ∀ v ∈ occurrenceVertices p (action p S), v.2.2 = j →
+            ∀ l, u v l = u b l + a v)) := by
+  classical
+  constructor
+  · intro bad L _ u hu
+    let l : L := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty L)
+    apply bad
+    exact (zeroCycles_iff B (action p S) j).mpr ⟨fun v => (u v l : Int), fun e he => hu e he l⟩
+  · intro good
+    have accepted := (source_consistency_iff B (action p S) j).mpr good
+    have available : (effectiveSourcePotential B (action p S) j).isSome := by
+      simp [effectiveSourcePotential, accepted]
+    let certified := (effectiveSourcePotential B (action p S) j).get available
+    let δ := certified.val
+    have hδ : Potential B (action p S) j δ := certified.property
+    have hcomputed : δ = computedSourcePotential B (action p S) j := by
+      simp [δ, certified, effectiveSourcePotential, accepted]
+    let V := (occurrenceVertices p (action p S)).toFinset.filter (fun v => v.2.2 = j)
+    have hV : V.Nonempty := by
+      obtain ⟨v, hv, hj⟩ := occurs
+      exact ⟨v, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨List.mem_toFinset.mpr hv, hj⟩⟩
+    obtain ⟨b, hb, hmin⟩ := V.exists_min_image δ hV
+    have hb' := Finset.mem_filter.mp hb
+    let a : Occurrence X → Nat := fun v => (δ v - δ b).toNat
+    have ha : ∀ v ∈ occurrenceVertices p (action p S), v.2.2 = j →
+        δ b ≤ δ v ∧ (a v : Int) = δ v - δ b := by
+      intro v hv hj
+      have hm := hmin v (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨List.mem_toFinset.mpr hv, hj⟩)
+      exact ⟨hm, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)⟩
+    refine ⟨δ, b, a, hcomputed, hδ, List.mem_toFinset.mp hb'.1, hb'.2, ?_, ha, ?_⟩
+    · simp [a]
+    · intro L u
+      constructor
+      · intro hu v hv hj l
+        have conn := (source_connected_iff_sort p B S hok b v
+          (List.mem_toFinset.mp hb'.1) hv).mpr (hb'.2.trans hj.symm)
+        have hd := common_difference p B S hok j
+          (f := fun w => (u w l : Int)) (g := δ)
+          (fun e he => hu e he l) hδ conn hb'.2
+        have hav := (ha v hv hj).2
+        omega
+      · intro hu e he l
+        have he' := (List.mem_filter.mp he).1
+        have hj : e.1.1.2.2 = j := by
+          simpa only [beq_iff_eq] using (List.mem_filter.mp he).2
+        have spec := edge_spec p B S hok he'
+        have hu1 := hu e.1.1 spec.1 hj l
+        have hu2 := hu e.1.2 spec.2.1 (spec.2.2.symm.trans hj) l
+        have ha1 := (ha e.1.1 spec.1 hj).2
+        have ha2 := (ha e.1.2 spec.2.1 (spec.2.2.symm.trans hj)).2
+        have hed := hδ e he
+        omega
+/-- Leaves retain their ordered positions even when all ranks coincide. -/
+def Leaves : FreeMagma Unit → Type
+  | .of _ => Unit
+  | .mul A B => Leaves A ⊕ Leaves B
+
+instance leavesNonempty : (T : FreeMagma Unit) → Nonempty (Leaves T)
+  | .of _ => inferInstanceAs (Nonempty Unit)
+  | .mul A B =>
+      letI := leavesNonempty A
+      inferInstanceAs (Nonempty (Leaves A ⊕ Leaves B))
+def fill : (T : FreeMagma Unit) → (Leaves T → Nat) → NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Code
+  | .of _, r => .of (r ())
+  | .mul A B, r => .mul (fill A (fun l => r (.inl l))) (fill B (fun l => r (.inr l)))
+private theorem fill_shift (T : FreeMagma Unit) (r : Leaves T → Nat) (a : Nat) :
+    fill T (fun l => r l + a) = NativeFiniteNormalInversion.shiftCode a (fill T r) := by
+  induction T using FreeMagma.rec with
+  | of => rfl
+  | mul A B ihA ihB =>
+      exact congrArg₂ FreeMagma.mul (ihA _) (ihB _)
+private theorem normal_subtree (C : NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Code) (q : List Bool)
+    (D : NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Code) (hC : NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Normal C)
+    (h : subtree C q = some D) : NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Normal D := by
+  induction q generalizing C with
+  | nil =>
+      simp only [subtree, Option.some.injEq] at h
+      exact h ▸ hC
+  | cons b q ih =>
+      cases C with
+      | of n => cases h
+      | mul A B =>
+          cases b
+          · exact ih A hC.1 h
+          · exact ih B hC.2.1 h
+/-- Actual occurrence subtrees turn the minimum rank base into a normal
+native block. Rank inverses and expansion recover the identical blocks. -/
+theorem source_canonical_block_recovery (p : Presentation X)
+    (B : List (BranchEquation X)) (S : SubstInfo)
+    (hok : (encodeEquations p (shapeEquations B)).unify SubstInfo.empty = .ok S)
+    (j : X) (occurs : ∃ v ∈ occurrenceVertices p (action p S), v.2.2 = j)
+    (good : ZeroCycles B (action p S) j) :
+    ∃ (b : Occurrence X) (a : Occurrence X → Nat),
+      b ∈ occurrenceVertices p (action p S) ∧ b.2.2 = j ∧ a b = 0 ∧
+      (∀ o ∈ occurrenceVertices p (action p S), o.2.2 = j →
+        computedSourcePotential B (action p S) j b ≤ computedSourcePotential B (action p S) j o ∧
+        (a o : Int) = computedSourcePotential B (action p S) j o -
+          computedSourcePotential B (action p S) j b) ∧
+      ∀ (T : FreeMagma Unit) (u : Occurrence X → Leaves T → Nat)
+        (C : X → NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Code),
+        BlockSolution B (action p S) j u →
+        (∀ x, NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Normal (C x)) →
+        (∀ v ∈ occurrenceVertices p (action p S), v.2.2 = j →
+          subtree (C v.1) v.2.1 = some (fill T (u v))) →
+        NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Normal (fill T (u b)) ∧
+        ∀ v ∈ occurrenceVertices p (action p S), v.2.2 = j →
+          fill T (u v) = NativeFiniteNormalInversion.shiftCode (a v) (fill T (u b)) ∧
+          NativeFiniteNormalInversion.expand (fill T (u v)) =
+            GenealogicalFiberTransport.substitution^[a v]
+              (NativeFiniteNormalInversion.expand (fill T (u b))) ∧
+          (∀ l, NativeFiniteNormalInversion.rankInverse (a v) (u v l) = some (u b l)) := by
+  obtain ⟨δ, b, a, hcomp, hδ, hb, hj, hab, hmin, law⟩ :=
+    (source_sort_minimum_base p B S hok j occurs).2 good
+  subst δ
+  refine ⟨b, a, hb, hj, hab, hmin, ?_⟩
+  intro T u C hu hC actual
+  have ranks := (law (Leaves T) u).mp hu
+  refine ⟨normal_subtree (C b.1) b.2.1 _ (hC b.1) (actual b hb hj), ?_⟩
+  intro v hv hvj
+  have heq : u v = fun l => u b l + a v := funext (ranks v hv hvj)
+  have code : fill T (u v) = NativeFiniteNormalInversion.shiftCode (a v) (fill T (u b)) := by
+    rw [heq]
+    exact fill_shift T (u b) (a v)
+  refine ⟨code, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · rw [code]
+    exact NativeFiniteNormalInversion.shift_expand (a v) (fill T (u b))
+  · intro l
+    exact ((NativeFiniteNormalInversion.exact_natural_rank_inverse (a v) (u v l)).1
+      (u b l)).mpr (ranks v hv hvj l).symm
+/-- The actual code at an occurrence address. Invalid addresses have a
+fixed default; all results below prove validity before using a block. -/
+def occurrenceCode (C : X → NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Code) (v : Occurrence X) :
+    NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Code :=
+  (subtree (C v.1) v.2.1).getD (.of 0)
+private def Fits (C : X → NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Code) :
+    Term (Occurrence X) → NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Code → Prop
+  | .of (.inl _), .of _ => True
+  | .of (.inl _), .mul _ _ => False
+  | .of (.inr v), D => D = occurrenceCode C v
+  | .mul A B, .mul D E => Fits C A D ∧ Fits C B E
+  | .mul _ _, .of _ => False
+private theorem subtree_child {A : Type} (C : FreeMagma A) (q : List Bool)
+    (D E : FreeMagma A) (h : subtree C q = some (.mul D E)) :
+    subtree C (q ++ [false]) = some D ∧ subtree C (q ++ [true]) = some E := by
+  induction q generalizing C with
+  | nil =>
+      simp only [subtree, Option.some.injEq] at h
+      subst C
+      constructor <;> simp [subtree]
+  | cons b q ih =>
+      cases C with
+      | of a => cases h
+      | mul A B => cases b <;> exact ih _ h
+private theorem fits_decorate (C : X → NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Code)
+    (w : X → NativeGroundSolutionSpace.Source) (x : X) (t : Term X)
+    (q : List Bool) (D : NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Code)
+    (actual : subtree (C x) q = some D)
+    (sh : shape D = evaluate w t) : Fits C (decorateFrom x q t) D := by
+  induction t generalizing q D with
+  | of a =>
+      cases a with
+      | inl b => cases D <;> simp_all [shape, evaluate, Fits, decorateFrom]
+      | inr j =>
+          change D = (subtree (C x) q).getD (.of 0)
+          rw [actual]
+          rfl
+  | mul A B ihA ihB =>
+      cases D with
+      | of n => cases sh
+      | mul D E =>
+          have hs : shape D = evaluate w A ∧ shape E = evaluate w B := by
+            injection sh with hD hE
+            exact ⟨hD, hE⟩
+          have hc := subtree_child (C x) q D E actual
+          exact ⟨ihA _ _ hc.1 hs.1, ihB _ _ hc.2 hs.2⟩
+private theorem fits_offsets (C : X → NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Code)
+    (A B : Term (Occurrence X)) (D E : NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Code)
+    (a : Nat) (hA : Fits C A D) (hB : Fits C B E)
+    (eq : D = NativeFiniteNormalInversion.shiftCode a E) :
+    ∀ e ∈ offsetComparisonEdges (a : Int) A B,
+      e.2 = (a : Int) ∧ occurrenceCode C e.1.1 =
+        NativeFiniteNormalInversion.shiftCode a (occurrenceCode C e.1.2) := by
+  induction A generalizing B D E with
+  | of b =>
+      cases B with
+      | of c =>
+          cases b with
+          | inl b => cases c <;> simp [offsetComparisonEdges]
+          | inr v =>
+              cases c with
+              | inl b => simp [offsetComparisonEdges]
+              | inr w =>
+                  intro e he
+                  have heq : e = ((v, w), (a : Int)) := List.mem_singleton.mp he
+                  subst e
+                  simp only [Fits] at hA hB
+                  exact ⟨rfl, by simpa only [hA, hB] using eq⟩
+      | mul l r => simp [offsetComparisonEdges]
+  | mul A₁ A₂ ihA ihB =>
+      cases B with
+      | of c => simp [offsetComparisonEdges]
+      | mul U V =>
+          cases E with
+          | of n => cases hB
+          | mul E F =>
+              subst D
+              rcases hA with ⟨hD, hE⟩
+              rcases hB with ⟨hU, hV⟩
+              intro e he
+              rcases List.mem_append.mp he with he | he
+              · exact ihA _ _ _ hD hU rfl e he
+              · exact ihB _ _ _ hE hV rfl e he
+private theorem actual_source_offsets (B : List (BranchEquation X))
+    (s : X → Term X) (C : X → NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Code)
+    (factor : ∀ x, evaluate (fun y => shape (C y)) (s x) = shape (C x))
+    (sat : ∀ b ∈ B, b.Holds C) :
+    ∀ e ∈ sourceOffsetEdges B s, ∃ a : Nat, e.2 = (a : Int) ∧
+      occurrenceCode C e.1.1 = NativeFiniteNormalInversion.shiftCode a
+        (occurrenceCode C e.1.2) := by
+  have fit (x : X) : Fits C (decorate s x) (C x) :=
+    fits_decorate C (fun y => shape (C y)) x (s x) [] (C x) (by simp [subtree]) (factor x).symm
+  intro e he
+  obtain ⟨b, hb, he⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp he
+  have hs := sat b hb
+  cases b with
+  | primitive z n => cases he
+  | collapse z x y => cases he
+  | shift z a x => exact ⟨a, fits_offsets C _ _ _ _ a (fit z) (fit x) hs e he⟩
+  | ordinary z x y =>
+      refine ⟨0, fits_offsets C _ _ (C z) (.mul (C x) (C y)) 0 (fit z) ?_ ?_ e he⟩
+      · exact ⟨fit x, fit y⟩
+      · simpa only [NativePositiveBranchReduction.shift_zero, BranchEquation.Holds] using hs
+  | same x y =>
+      refine ⟨0, fits_offsets C _ _ _ _ 0 (fit x) (fit y) ?_ e he⟩
+      simpa only [NativePositiveBranchReduction.shift_zero, BranchEquation.Holds] using hs
+private def codeTree : NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Code → FreeMagma Unit
+  | .of _ => .of ()
+  | .mul A B => .mul (codeTree A) (codeTree B)
+private def groundShape : FreeMagma Unit → NativeGroundSolutionSpace.Source
+  | .of _ => .of true
+  | .mul A B => .mul (groundShape A) (groundShape B)
+private theorem codeTree_shape (D : NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Code) :
+    groundShape (codeTree D) = shape D := by
+  induction D with
+  | of n => rfl
+  | mul A B ihA ihB => exact congrArg₂ FreeMagma.mul ihA ihB
+private def readRanks : (T : FreeMagma Unit) → NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Code → Leaves T → Nat
+  | .of _, .of n => fun _ => n
+  | .mul A B, .mul D E => Sum.elim (readRanks A D) (readRanks B E)
+  | _, _ => fun _ => 0
+private theorem fill_readRanks (T : FreeMagma Unit) (D : NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Code)
+    (sh : shape D = groundShape T) : fill T (readRanks T D) = D := by
+  induction T using FreeMagma.rec generalizing D with
+  | of u => cases D with
+    | of n => rfl
+    | mul A B => cases sh
+  | mul A B ihA ihB =>
+      cases D with
+      | of n => cases sh
+      | mul D E =>
+          have hs : shape D = groundShape A ∧ shape E = groundShape B := by
+            injection sh with hD hE
+            exact ⟨hD, hE⟩
+          exact congrArg₂ FreeMagma.mul (ihA D hs.1) (ihB E hs.2)
+private theorem readRanks_shift (T : FreeMagma Unit) (D : NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Code)
+    (sh : shape D = groundShape T) (a : Nat) (l : Leaves T) :
+    readRanks T (NativeFiniteNormalInversion.shiftCode a D) l = readRanks T D l + a := by
+  induction T using FreeMagma.rec generalizing D with
+  | of u => cases D with
+    | of n => rfl
+    | mul A B => cases sh
+  | mul A B ihA ihB =>
+      cases D with
+      | of n => cases sh
+      | mul D E =>
+          have hs : shape D = groundShape A ∧ shape E = groundShape B := by
+            injection sh with hD hE
+            exact ⟨hD, hE⟩
+          cases l with
+          | inl l => exact ihA D hs.1 l

+private theorem code_at_residual (w : X → NativeGroundSolutionSpace.Source)
+    (t : Term X) (D : NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Code) (q : List Bool) (j : X)
+    (sh : shape D = evaluate w t)
+    (occ : subtree t q = some (.of (.inr j))) :
+    ∃ E, subtree D q = some E ∧ shape E = w j := by
+  induction q generalizing t D with
+  | nil =>
+      simp only [subtree, Option.some.injEq] at occ
+      subst t

+  | cons b q ih =>

+      | of c => cases occ
+      | mul A B =>

+          | of n => cases sh
+          | mul D E =>
+              have hs : shape D = evaluate w A ∧ shape E = evaluate w B := by

+                exact ⟨hD, hE⟩

+              · exact ih A D hs.1 occ
+              · exact ih B E hs.2 occ
+private theorem actual_occurrence_code (p : Presentation X) (B : List (BranchEquation X))
+    (S : SubstInfo)
+    (hok : (encodeEquations p (shapeEquations B)).unify SubstInfo.empty = .ok S)
+    (C : X → NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Code)
+    (factor : ∀ x, evaluate (fun y => shape (C y)) (action p S x) = shape (C x))
+    (v : Occurrence X) (hv : v ∈ occurrenceVertices p (action p S)) :
+    subtree (C v.1) v.2.1 = some (occurrenceCode C v) ∧
+      shape (occurrenceCode C v) = shape (C v.2.2) := by
+  have occ := (mgu_occurrence_graph_exact p (shapeEquations B) S hok).1 v |>.mp hv
+  obtain ⟨D, hD, hs⟩ := code_at_residual (fun y => shape (C y))
+    (action p S v.1) (C v.1) v.2.1 v.2.2 (factor v.1).symm occ
+  have eq : occurrenceCode C v = D := by simp only [occurrenceCode, hD, Option.getD_some]
+  exact ⟨by rw [eq]; exact hD, by rw [eq]; exact hs⟩
+private theorem actual_rank_blocks (p : Presentation X) (B : List (BranchEquation X))
+    (S : SubstInfo)
+    (hok : (encodeEquations p (shapeEquations B)).unify SubstInfo.empty = .ok S)
+    (C : X → NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Code)
+    (factor : ∀ x, evaluate (fun y => shape (C y)) (action p S x) = shape (C x))
+    (sat : ∀ b ∈ B, b.Holds C) (j : X) :
+    let T := codeTree (C j)
+    let u := fun v => readRanks T (occurrenceCode C v)
+    BlockSolution B (action p S) j u ∧
+      ∀ v ∈ occurrenceVertices p (action p S), v.2.2 = j →

+    (by omega) (by simp only [Nat.zero_add]; change u * z ≤ N; nlinarith)
+    (by simp only [Nat.zero_add]; change 0 ≤ d - z + 2 * z - 2 * u * z; nlinarith)
+    (by norm_num; omega) (fun i _ hi => hZ i (by omega))
+  have hsZ : InStrip f (3 * N) (d - z) Z0 := by simpa [Z0] using hsZ0
+  have hmZ : (Z0.map f).sum = -2 * z * (u - 1) := by simpa [Z0, u] using hmZ0
+  obtain ⟨hlp, hln⟩ := hZ (D - 1) (by omega)
+  change f last = 2 * N - 2 * u * z at hlp
+  change f (last + 1) = -2 * N - 4 * u * z at hln
+  have ht : InStrip f (3 * N) (d - z + (Z0.map f).sum) [gamma, last, last + 1] := by
+    simp only [InStrip]
+    rw [hmZ, show f gamma = N - z from hc, hlp, hln]
+    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
+      nlinarith only [huZ, hd, hdN, he, hz, h4z, hde]
+  have hsYZ := inStrip_append hs1 (by
+    rw [hm1]
+    convert (inStrip_append hsZ ht) using 1 <;> nlinarith only [hde, hez])
+  have hsmall : InStrip f (3 * N) (N + e - 2 * v * e) [0] := by
+    have hh := inStrip_prefix hs1 0
+    simp only [List.take_zero, List.map_nil, List.sum_nil, add_zero] at hh
+    simp only [InStrip, ha]
+    exact ⟨hpre, by omega, by omega, by omega⟩
+  have hsinsert := inStrip_append hsmall (by
+    simp only [List.map_singleton, List.sum_singleton, ha]
+    convert hsYZ using 1 <;> ring)
+  have hsall := inStrip_append hs0 (by rw [hm0]; convert hsinsert using 1 <;> ring)
+  have hstrip : InStrip f (3 * N) 0 L := by
+    change InStrip f (3 * N) 0 (1 :: (Y0 ++ [0] ++ Y1 ++ Z0 ++ [gamma, last, last + 1]))
+    refine ⟨by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
+    simpa only [zero_add, hb, List.append_assoc] using hsall
+  have hYjoin : Y0 ++ Y1 = List.range' 2 (2 * B) := by
+    dsimp [Y0, Y1]
+    rw [List.range'_append_1]
+    congr 1
+    omega
+  have hZjoin : Z0 ++ [last, last + 1] = List.range' (2 * B + 3) (2 * D) := by
+    dsimp [Z0, last]
+    rw [show [2 * B + 3 + 2 * (D - 1), 2 * B + 3 + 2 * (D - 1) + 1] =
+      List.range' (2 * B + 3 + 2 * (D - 1)) 2 by simp [List.range'_succ],
+      List.range'_append_1]
+    congr 1
+    omega
+  have hinv : [0, 1] ++ (Y0 ++ Y1) ++ [gamma] ++ (Z0 ++ [last, last + 1]) =
+      List.range (2 * B + 2 * D + 3) := by
+    rw [hYjoin, hZjoin]
+    have hpref : [0, 1] ++ List.range' 2 (2 * B) = List.range' 0 (2 * B + 2) := by
+      change List.range' 0 2 ++ List.range' (0 + 2) (2 * B) = _
+      rw [List.range'_append_1]
+      congr 1
+      omega
+    have hmid : List.range' 0 (2 * B + 2) ++ [gamma] =
+        List.range' 0 (2 * B + 3) := by
+      simpa only [gamma, Nat.zero_add] using
+        (List.range'_1_concat (s := 0) (n := 2 * B + 2)).symm
+    change ([0, 1] ++ List.range' 2 (2 * B)) ++ [gamma] ++
+      List.range' (2 * B + 3) (2 * D) = _
+    rw [hpref, hmid]
+    have hjoin := List.range'_append_1 (s := 0) (m := 2 * B + 3) (n := 2 * D)
+    simp only [Nat.zero_add] at hjoin
+    rw [hjoin, List.range_eq_range']
+    congr 1
+    omega
+  refine ⟨L, ?_, hstrip, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · rw [← hinv]
+    apply List.perm_iff_count.mpr
+    intro x
+    simp only [L, List.count_append, List.count_cons, List.count_nil]
+    omega
+  · simp only [L, List.map_append, List.sum_append, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons,
+      List.map_nil, List.sum_nil, ha, hb, hm0, hm1, hmZ, hlp, hln]
+    rw [show f gamma = N - z from hc]
+    nlinarith only [hde, hez, huZ]
+  · let p := fun j => decide (j ≠ 0 ∧ j ≠ 1 ∧ j ≠ 2 * B + 2)
+    have hkeepY (R : List ℕ) (hR : ∀ x ∈ R, 2 ≤ x ∧ x < 2 * B + 2) :
+        R.filter p = R := by
+      apply List.filter_eq_self.mpr
+      intro x hx
+      have := hR x hx
+      simp only [p, decide_eq_true_eq]
+      omega
+    have hy0 : Y0.filter p = Y0 := hkeepY Y0 (by
+      intro x hx
+      obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.mem_range'.mp hx
+      omega)
+    have hy1 : Y1.filter p = Y1 := hkeepY Y1 (by
+      intro x hx
+      obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.mem_range'.mp hx
+      omega)
+    have hz0 : Z0.filter p = Z0 := by
+      apply List.filter_eq_self.mpr
+      intro x hx
+      obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.mem_range'.mp hx
+      simp only [p, decide_eq_true_eq]
+      dsimp [Z0] at *
+      omega
+    change L.filter p = _
+    dsimp only [L]
+    simp only [List.filter_append, hy0, hy1, hz0]
+    have hp1 : p 1 = false := by simp [p]
+    have hp0 : p 0 = false := by simp [p]
+    have hpg : p gamma = false := by simp [p, gamma]
+    have hpl : p last = true := by simp only [p, decide_eq_true_eq]; dsimp [last]; omega
+    have hpl' : p (last + 1) = true := by simp only [p, decide_eq_true_eq]; dsimp [last]; omega
+    simp only [List.filter_cons, List.filter_nil, hp1, hp0, hpg, hpl, hpl',
+      Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, List.nil_append, List.append_nil]
+    rw [hYjoin, List.append_assoc, hZjoin]

+private theorem aligned_power (A B D : ℕ) (hD : 0 < D)
+    (d e z : ℤ)
+    (hd : d = 4 * (4 : ℤ) ^ B * 4 ^ D + 2 * 4 ^ D + 1)
+    (he : e = 4 * (4 : ℤ) ^ D * 4 ^ A + 2 * 4 ^ A + 1)
+    (hz : z = 4 * (4 : ℤ) ^ A * 4 ^ B + 2 * 4 ^ B + 1)
+    (hde : e ≤ d) (hdz : z ≤ d) :
+    ∃ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ D ∧
+      d ≤ (4 : ℤ) ^ j * z ∧ (4 : ℤ) ^ j * z ≤ 2 * (d + z) := by
+  let F : ℤ := (4 : ℤ) ^ A
+  let G : ℤ := (4 : ℤ) ^ B
+  let H : ℤ := (4 : ℤ) ^ D
+  change d = 4 * G * H + 2 * H + 1 at hd
+  change e = 4 * H * F + 2 * F + 1 at he
+  change z = 4 * F * G + 2 * G + 1 at hz
+  have hF : 1 ≤ F := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
+  have hG : 1 ≤ G := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
+  have hH : 1 ≤ H := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
+  have hAB : A ≤ B := by
+    by_contra h
+    have h4 : 4 * G ≤ F := by
+      have hh := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℤ) ≤ 4) (show B + 1 ≤ A by omega)
+      simpa only [pow_succ, G, F, mul_comm] using hh
+    have hprod := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show (3 : ℤ) ≤ F - G by omega)
+      (show 0 ≤ H by omega)
+    nlinarith only [hd, he, hde, hprod, hF, hH]
+  have hAD : A ≤ D := by
+    by_contra h
+    have h4 : 4 * H ≤ F := by
+      have hh := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℤ) ≤ 4) (show D + 1 ≤ A by omega)
+      simpa only [pow_succ, H, F, mul_comm] using hh
+    have hprod := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hG (show 0 ≤ F - H by omega)
+    nlinarith only [hd, hz, hdz, hprod, h4, hG, hH]
+  have hFG : F ≤ G := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hAB
+  by_cases hAD' : A = D
+  · have hFH : F = H := by simp only [F, H, hAD']
+    have hd' := hd
+    rw [← hFH] at hd'
+    have hGF : G = F := by nlinarith only [hd', hz, hdz, hFG]
+    have hdz' : d = z := by rw [hd, hz, ← hFH, hGF]
+    refine ⟨1, by omega, hD, ?_, ?_⟩
+    rw [pow_one, ← hdz']
+    · nlinarith only [hd, hG, hH, mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ G by omega) (show 0 ≤ H by omega)]
+    · rw [pow_one, ← hdz']; omega
+  · let j := D - A
+    let q : ℤ := (4 : ℤ) ^ j
+    have hj : 1 ≤ j := by dsimp [j]; omega
+    have hq : 1 ≤ q := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
+    have hFq : F * q = H := by
+      dsimp [F, q, H, j]
+      rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le hAD]
+    have hqH : q ≤ H := by
+      exact pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (show j ≤ D by dsimp [j]; omega)
+    have hqz : q * z = 4 * G * H + q * (2 * G + 1) := by
+      rw [hz, ← hFq]
+      ring
+    have hlow := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show (1 : ℤ) ≤ 2 * G + 1 - 2 * F by omega)
+      (show 0 ≤ q by omega)
+    have hupp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hqH (show 0 ≤ 2 * G + 1 by omega)
+    refine ⟨j, hj, by dsimp [j]; omega, ?_, ?_⟩
+    · change d ≤ q * z
+      nlinarith only [hd, hqz, hlow, hFq, hq]
+    · change q * z ≤ 2 * (d + z)
+      have hGH := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ G by omega) (show 0 ≤ H by omega)
+      have hz0 : 0 ≤ z := by nlinarith only [hz, hF, hG, mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ F by omega) (show 0 ≤ G by omega)]
+      nlinarith only [hd, hqz, hupp, hGH, hH, hz0]
+
+
+set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
+theorem three_blocks (A B D : ℕ) (hA : 0 < A) (hB : 0 < B) (hD : 0 < D)
+    (N d e z : ℤ) (hd : 0 < d) (he : 0 < e) (hz : 0 < z)
+    (hdN : d < N) (heN : e < N) (hzN : z < N) (hde : e ≤ d) (hdz : z ≤ d)
+    (hXY : 2 * (4 : ℤ) ^ A * d = N + e)
+    (hYZ : 2 * (4 : ℤ) ^ B * e = N + z)
+    (hZX : 2 * (4 : ℤ) ^ D * z = N + d)
+    (hdval : d = 4 * (4 : ℤ) ^ B * 4 ^ D + 2 * 4 ^ D + 1)
+    (heval : e = 4 * (4 : ℤ) ^ D * 4 ^ A + 2 * 4 ^ A + 1)
+    (hzval : z = 4 * (4 : ℤ) ^ A * 4 ^ B + 2 * 4 ^ B + 1)
+    (f : ℕ → ℤ) (ha : f 0 = N - d) (hb : f (2 * A + 1) = N - e)
+    (hc : f (2 * A + 2 * B + 2) = N - z)
+    (hX : ∀ j < A, f (1 + 2 * j) = 2 * N - 2 * (4 : ℤ) ^ j * d ∧
+      f (1 + 2 * j + 1) = -2 * N - 4 * (4 : ℤ) ^ j * d)
+    (hY : ∀ j < B, f (2 * A + 2 + 2 * j) = 2 * N - 2 * (4 : ℤ) ^ j * e ∧
+      f (2 * A + 2 + 2 * j + 1) = -2 * N - 4 * (4 : ℤ) ^ j * e)
+    (hZ : ∀ j < D, f (2 * A + 2 * B + 3 + 2 * j) = 2 * N - 2 * (4 : ℤ) ^ j * z ∧
+      f (2 * A + 2 * B + 3 + 2 * j + 1) = -2 * N - 4 * (4 : ℤ) ^ j * z) :
+    ∃ L : List ℕ, L.Perm (List.range (2 * A + 2 * B + 2 * D + 3)) ∧
+      InStrip f (3 * N) 0 L ∧ (L.map f).sum = 0 ∧
+      L.filter (fun j => decide (j ≠ 0 ∧ j ≠ 2 * A + 1 ∧ j ≠ 2 * A + 2 * B + 2)) =
+        List.range' 1 (2 * A) ++ List.range' (2 * A + 2) (2 * B) ++
+          List.range' (2 * A + 2 * B + 3) (2 * D) := by
+  let F : ℤ := (4 : ℤ) ^ A
+  let G : ℤ := (4 : ℤ) ^ B
+  let H : ℤ := (4 : ℤ) ^ D
+  change 2 * F * d = N + e at hXY
+  change 2 * G * e = N + z at hYZ
+  change 2 * H * z = N + d at hZX
+  have hF : 4 ≤ F := by
+    simpa only [F, pow_one] using
+      pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℤ) ≤ 4) hA
+  have hFd : F * d < N := by nlinarith only [hXY, heN]
+  have hGe : G * e < N := by nlinarith only [hYZ, hzN]
+  have hHz : H * z < N := by nlinarith only [hZX, hdN]
+  have h4d : 4 * d < N := by nlinarith only [hF, hd, hFd]
+  have hex : ∃ s : ℕ, s < B ∧ d ≤ (4 : ℤ) ^ (s + 1) * e := by
+    refine ⟨B - 1, by omega, ?_⟩
+    rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hB]
+    change d ≤ G * e
+    nlinarith only [hd, h4d, hYZ, hz]
+  let s := Nat.find hex
+  let v : ℤ := (4 : ℤ) ^ s
+  have hs : s < B := (Nat.find_spec hex).1
+  have hcut : d ≤ 4 * v * e := by
+    have hh := (Nat.find_spec hex).2
+    simpa only [pow_succ, v, s, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hh
+  have hbefore : v * e ≤ d := by
+    by_cases hs0 : s = 0
+    · simpa only [v, hs0, pow_zero, one_mul] using hde
+    · have hm := Nat.find_min hex (show s - 1 < Nat.find hex by change s - 1 < s; omega)
+      have hpred : s - 1 < B := by omega
+      have hnot : ¬ d ≤ (4 : ℤ) ^ s * e := by
+        intro hh
+        apply hm
+        exact ⟨hpred, by simpa only [Nat.sub_add_cancel (show 1 ≤ s by omega)] using hh⟩
+      change (4 : ℤ) ^ s * e ≤ d
+      omega
+  obtain ⟨jZ, hjZ, hjZD, hzcut, hzupper⟩ := aligned_power A B D hD d e z hdval heval hzval hde hdz
+  let u : ℤ := (4 : ℤ) ^ (jZ - 1)
+  have hu : 4 * u = (4 : ℤ) ^ jZ := by
+    dsimp [u]
+    calc
+      4 * (4 : ℤ) ^ (jZ - 1) = 4 ^ ((jZ - 1) + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
+      _ = 4 ^ jZ := by congr 1; omega
+  rw [← hu] at hzcut hzupper
+  have hv1 : 1 ≤ v := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
+  have hu1 : 1 ≤ u := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
+  let beta := 2 * A + 1
+  let gamma := 2 * A + 2 * B + 2
+  let X := List.range' 1 (2 * A)
+  let Y0 := List.range' (2 * A + 2) (2 * s)
+  let Y1 := List.range' (2 * A + 2 + 2 * s) (2 * (B - s))
+  let Z0 := List.range' (2 * A + 2 * B + 3) (2 * (jZ - 1))
+  let Z1 := List.range' (2 * A + 2 * B + 3 + 2 * (jZ - 1)) (2 * (D - (jZ - 1)))
+  let L := [beta] ++ X ++ Y0 ++ [0] ++ Y1 ++ Z0 ++ [gamma] ++ Z1
+  obtain ⟨hsX, hmX⟩ := descending_pairs f N d (N - e) 1 0 A (by omega)
+    (by simpa only [Nat.zero_add, F] using le_of_lt hFd)
+    (by simp only [Nat.zero_add]; change 0 ≤ N - e + 2 * d - 2 * F * d; omega)
+    (by norm_num; omega) (fun i _ hi => hX i (by omega))
+  have hSX : InStrip f (3 * N) (N - e) X := by simpa [X] using hsX
+  have hMX : (X.map f).sum = -2 * d * (F - 1) := by simpa [X, F] using hmX
+  obtain ⟨hsY0, hmY0⟩ := descending_pairs f N e (2 * d - 2 * e) (2 * A + 2) 0 s
+    (by omega) (by simp only [Nat.zero_add]; change v * e ≤ N; omega)
+    (by simp only [Nat.zero_add]; change 0 ≤ 2 * d - 2 * e + 2 * e - 2 * v * e; nlinarith only [hbefore])
+    (by norm_num; omega) (fun i _ hi => hY i (by omega))
+  have hSY0 : InStrip f (3 * N) (2 * (d - e)) Y0 := by convert hsY0 using 1 <;> simp [Y0] <;> ring
+  have hMY0 : (Y0.map f).sum = -2 * e * (v - 1) := by simpa [Y0, v] using hmY0
+  obtain ⟨hsY1, hmY1⟩ := descending_pairs f N e (N + d - 2 * e) (2 * A + 2) s (B - s)
+    (by omega) (by simpa only [Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt hs), G] using le_of_lt hGe)
+    (by rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt hs)]; change 0 ≤ N + d - 2 * e + 2 * e - 2 * G * e; omega)
+    (by change N + d - 2 * e + 2 * N + 2 * e - 4 * v * e ≤ 3 * N; omega)
+    (fun i _ hi => hY i (by omega))
+  have hSY1 : InStrip f (3 * N) (N + d - 2 * v * e) Y1 := by convert hsY1 using 1 <;> dsimp [Y1, v] <;> ring
+  have hMY1 : (Y1.map f).sum = -2 * e * (G - v) := by
+    simpa [Y1, v, G, Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt hs)] using hmY1
+  obtain ⟨hsZ0, hmZ0⟩ := descending_pairs f N z (d - z) (2 * A + 2 * B + 3) 0 (jZ - 1)
+    (by omega) (by simp only [Nat.zero_add]; change u * z ≤ N; nlinarith only [hzupper, hdN, hzN])
+    (by simp only [Nat.zero_add]; change 0 ≤ d - z + 2 * z - 2 * u * z; nlinarith only [hzupper])
+    (by norm_num; omega) (fun i _ hi => hZ i (by omega))
+  have hSZ0 : InStrip f (3 * N) (d - z) Z0 := by simpa [Z0] using hsZ0
+  have hMZ0 : (Z0.map f).sum = -2 * z * (u - 1) := by simpa [Z0, u] using hmZ0
+  have hjZ' : jZ - 1 ≤ D := by omega
+  obtain ⟨hsZ1, hmZ1⟩ := descending_pairs f N z (N + d - 2 * z) (2 * A + 2 * B + 3)
+    (jZ - 1) (D - (jZ - 1)) (by omega)
+    (by simpa only [Nat.add_sub_of_le hjZ', H] using le_of_lt hHz)
+    (by rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le hjZ']; change 0 ≤ N + d - 2 * z + 2 * z - 2 * H * z; omega)
+    (by change N + d - 2 * z + 2 * N + 2 * z - 4 * u * z ≤ 3 * N; omega)
+    (fun i _ hi => hZ i (by omega))
+  have hSZ1 : InStrip f (3 * N) (N + d - 2 * u * z) Z1 := by convert hsZ1 using 1 <;> dsimp [Z1, u] <;> ring
+  have hMZ1 : (Z1.map f).sum = -2 * z * (H - u) := by
+    simpa [Z1, u, H, Nat.add_sub_of_le hjZ'] using hmZ1
+  have hsg : InStrip f (3 * N) (d + z - 2 * u * z) [gamma] := by
+    have hh := inStrip_prefix hSZ1 0
+    simp only [List.take_zero, List.map_nil, List.sum_nil, add_zero] at hh
+    simp only [InStrip, show f gamma = N - z from hc]
+    constructor
+    · nlinarith only [hzupper]
+    constructor
+    · nlinarith only [hd, hdN, hzN,
+        mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ u by omega) (le_of_lt hz)]
+    exact ⟨by nlinarith only [hh.1], by nlinarith only [hh.2]⟩
+  have hsga := inStrip_append hsg (by simp only [List.map_singleton, List.sum_singleton]; rw [show f gamma = N - z from hc]; convert hSZ1 using 1 <;> ring)
+  have hsZ := inStrip_append hSZ0 (by rw [hMZ0]; convert hsga using 1 <;> ring)
+  have hsYZ := inStrip_append hSY1 (by rw [hMY1]; convert hsZ using 1 <;> nlinarith only [hYZ])
+  have hsa : InStrip f (3 * N) (2 * d - 2 * v * e) [0] := by
+    have hh := inStrip_prefix hSY1 0
+    simp only [List.take_zero, List.map_nil, List.sum_nil, add_zero] at hh
+    simp only [InStrip, ha]
+    constructor
+    · nlinarith only [hbefore]
+    constructor
+    · nlinarith only [hd, h4d,
+        mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ v by omega) (le_of_lt he)]
+    exact ⟨by nlinarith only [hh.1], by nlinarith only [hh.2]⟩
+  have hsaa := inStrip_append hsa (by simp only [List.map_singleton, List.sum_singleton, ha]; convert hsYZ using 1 <;> ring)
+  have hsY := inStrip_append hSY0 (by rw [hMY0]; convert hsaa using 1 <;> ring)
+  have hsXY := inStrip_append hSX (by rw [hMX]; convert hsY using 1 <;> nlinarith only [hXY])
+  have hstrip : InStrip f (3 * N) 0 L := by
+    change InStrip f (3 * N) 0 (beta :: (X ++ Y0 ++ [0] ++ Y1 ++ Z0 ++ [gamma] ++ Z1))
+    refine ⟨by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
+    simpa only [zero_add, show f beta = N - e from hb, List.append_assoc] using hsXY
+  have hYjoin : Y0 ++ Y1 = List.range' (2 * A + 2) (2 * B) := by
+    dsimp [Y0, Y1]
+    rw [List.range'_append_1]
+    congr 1
+    omega
+  have hZjoin : Z0 ++ Z1 = List.range' (2 * A + 2 * B + 3) (2 * D) := by
+    dsimp [Z0, Z1]
+    rw [List.range'_append_1]
+    congr 1
+    omega
+  have hinv : [0] ++ X ++ [beta] ++ (Y0 ++ Y1) ++ [gamma] ++ (Z0 ++ Z1) =
+      List.range (2 * A + 2 * B + 2 * D + 3) := by
+    rw [hYjoin, hZjoin]

+private abbrev Both (G : SimpleGraph V) (r x : V) :=

+private lemma only_le_product [Finite V] (hG : G.Connected) (r x : V) :
+    Nat.card (Only G x r) ≤ Nat.card (Both G r x) * Nat.card (Only G r x) := by

+  have hi : Function.Injective f := by

+    apply Subtype.ext

+    rfl

+    have hh : rootedCount G T r {y} + 1 ≤ rootedCount G S r ∅ := by omega

+/-- Pandey--Patra Conjecture 3.25, with all maximizers and the native small blocks. -/

+

+  refine ⟨H, hull_connected hG hS, fun _ hx => mem_hull hx, ?_⟩
+  intro z
+  rw [Subgraph.preconnected_iff_forall_exists_walk_subgraph]
+  intro u v hu hv
+  have huH : u ∈ hull G S := hu.1
+  have hvH : v ∈ hull G S := hv.1
+  have huz : u ≠ z := by simpa using hu.2

+  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, p, hp, hup⟩ := huH
+  obtain ⟨c, hc, d, hd, q, hq, hvq⟩ := hvH

+  obtain ⟨t, ht, pt, hpt⟩ := endpoint_avoiding q hq hvq hvz

+  have htS : t ∈ S := ht.elim (fun he => he ▸ hc) (fun he => he ▸ hd)

+  have htz : t ≠ z := (hpt t pt.end_mem_support).2

+  constructor
+  · intro w hw

+    have ha := hk a ((Walk.mem_verts_toSubgraph _).mp hab.fst_mem)
+    have hb := hk b ((Walk.mem_verts_toSubgraph _).mp hab.snd_mem)
+    exact ⟨ha, hb, ha.1, hb.1, k.toSubgraph.adj_sub hab⟩
+
+end

+/-- A source composition of length l, with its positive parts explicitly indexed. -/
+abbrev Parts (l : ℕ) := Fin l → ℕ+
+
+/-- (i,0) is v_(i+1); (i,r), 1 ≤ r < a_i, is w_(i+1,r). -/
+abbrev Vertex {l : ℕ} (a : Parts l) := (i : Fin l) × Fin (a i).val
+
+/-- Source edge list, before Mathlib's symmetric, loopless closure. -/
+def edgeRel {l : ℕ} (a : Parts l) (u v : Vertex a) : Prop :=
+  (u.1 = v.1 ∧ u.2.val = 0 ∧ v.2.val ≠ 0) ∨
+  (u.2.val = 0 ∧ v.2.val = 0 ∧ u.1.val + 1 = v.1.val)
+
+/-- C_a: a spine path with a_i-1 pendant leaves at its ith vertex. -/
+def caterpillar {l : ℕ} (a : Parts l) : SimpleGraph (Vertex a) :=
+  SimpleGraph.fromRel (edgeRel a)
+
+/-- Equation (2.1): finite principal specialization of the ordinary CSF.
+The source explicitly changes to colors 0,...,k-1 in this equation. -/
+noncomputable def ps {V : Type*} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (k : ℕ) :
+    Polynomial ℤ :=
+  ∑ c : G.Coloring (Fin k), Polynomial.X ^ (∑ v : V, (c v).val)
+
+/-- alpha_j, with j represented by a positive natural. -/
+def alpha (j : ℕ+) : Parts 5 :=
+  fun i => if i.val = 0 then 5 else if i.val = 1 then j else
+    if i.val = 2 then j else if i.val = 3 then 4 else 3
+
+/-- beta_j, with j represented by a positive natural. -/
+def beta (j : ℕ+) : Parts 5 :=
+  fun i => if i.val = 0 then 4 else if i.val = 1 then j else
+    if i.val = 2 then j else if i.val = 3 then 5 else 3
+
+/-- Remark 3.11, first question only; every positive integer j is quantified. -/
+def claim : Prop :=
+  ∀ j : ℕ+,
+    ps (caterpillar (alpha j)) 2 ≠ ps (caterpillar (beta j)) 2 ∧
+    ps (caterpillar (alpha j)) 3 = ps (caterpillar (beta j)) 3
+
+
+private def root {l : ℕ} (a : Parts l) (i : Fin l) : Fin (a i).val :=
+  ⟨0, (a i).pos⟩
+
+private abbrev Leaf {l : ℕ} (a : Parts l) (i : Fin l) :=
+  {r : Fin (a i).val // r ≠ root a i}
+
+private def SpineGood {l k : ℕ} (c : Fin l → Fin k) : Prop :=
+  ∀ i j, i.val + 1 = j.val → c i ≠ c j
+
+private abbrev Spine (l k : ℕ) := {c : Fin l → Fin k // SpineGood c}
+
+private abbrev Leaves {l k : ℕ} (a : Parts l) (c : Fin l → Fin k) :=
+  ∀ i, Leaf a i → {d : Fin k // d ≠ c i}
+
+private def assemble {l k : ℕ} (a : Parts l) (c : Spine l k) (f : Leaves a c.val) :
+    (caterpillar a).Coloring (Fin k) :=
+  SimpleGraph.Coloring.mk (fun v => if h : v.2 = root a v.1 then c.val v.1
+    else (f v.1 ⟨v.2, h⟩).val) (by
+    intro u v h
+    rcases h with ⟨huv, h | h⟩
+    · rcases h with ⟨hi, hu, hv⟩ | ⟨hu, hv, hij⟩
+      · have hu' : u.2 = root a u.1 := Fin.ext hu
+        have hv' : v.2 ≠ root a v.1 := fun e => hv (congrArg Fin.val e)
+        simp only [dite_eq_left hu', dite_eq_right hv']
+        simpa only [hi] using (f v.1 ⟨v.2, hv'⟩).property.symm
+      · have hu' : u.2 = root a u.1 := Fin.ext hu
+        have hv' : v.2 = root a v.1 := Fin.ext hv
+        simp only [dite_eq_left hu', dite_eq_left hv']
+        exact c.property _ _ hij
+    · rcases h with ⟨hi, hv, hu⟩ | ⟨hv, hu, hji⟩
+      · have hu' : u.2 ≠ root a u.1 := fun e => hu (congrArg Fin.val e)
+        have hv' : v.2 = root a v.1 := Fin.ext hv
+        simp only [dite_eq_right hu', dite_eq_left hv']
+        simpa only [hi] using (f u.1 ⟨u.2, hu'⟩).property
+      · have hu' : u.2 = root a u.1 := Fin.ext hu
+        have hv' : v.2 = root a v.1 := Fin.ext hv
+        simp only [dite_eq_left hu', dite_eq_left hv']
+        exact (c.property _ _ hji).symm)
+
+private def restrictSpine {l k : ℕ} {a : Parts l}
+    (c : (caterpillar a).Coloring (Fin k)) : Spine l k :=
+  ⟨fun i => c ⟨i, root a i⟩, by
+    intro i j hij
+    apply c.valid
+    constructor
+    · intro h
+      have he : i.val = j.val := congrArg Fin.val (congrArg Sigma.fst h)
+      omega
+    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl, hij⟩)⟩
+
+private def restrictLeaves {l k : ℕ} {a : Parts l}
+    (c : (caterpillar a).Coloring (Fin k)) : Leaves a (restrictSpine c).val :=
+  fun i r => ⟨c ⟨i, r.val⟩, by
+    apply c.valid
+    constructor
+    · intro h
+      apply r.property
+      exact eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj h).2
+    · apply Or.inr
+      apply Or.inl
+      refine ⟨rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
+      intro h
+      exact r.property (Fin.ext h)⟩
+
+private def coloringEquiv {l k : ℕ} (a : Parts l) :
+    (caterpillar a).Coloring (Fin k) ≃ (c : Spine l k) × Leaves a c.val where
+  toFun c := ⟨restrictSpine c, restrictLeaves c⟩
+  invFun c := assemble a c.1 c.2
+  left_inv c := by
+    apply RelHom.ext
+    intro v
+    rcases v with ⟨i,r⟩
+    change (if h : r = root a i then c ⟨i, root a i⟩ else c ⟨i,r⟩) = _
+    by_cases h : r = root a i
+    · subst r; simp
+    · simp [h]
+  right_inv cf := by
+    rcases cf with ⟨c,f⟩
+    have h : restrictSpine (assemble a c f) = c := by
+      apply Subtype.ext
+      funext i
+      change (if h : root a i = root a i then c.val i else (f i ⟨root a i,h⟩).val) = c.val i
+      simp
+    apply Sigma.ext h
+    apply heq_of_eq
+    funext i r
+    apply Subtype.ext
+    change (if h : r.val = root a i then c.val i else (f i ⟨r.val,h⟩).val) = (f i r).val
+    simp [r.property]
+
+
+attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
+
+private noncomputable def leafSum {k : ℕ} (c : Fin k) : Polynomial ℤ :=
+  ∑ d : {d : Fin k // d ≠ c}, Polynomial.X ^ d.val.val
+
+private noncomputable def blockWeight {k : ℕ} (m : ℕ+) (c : Fin k) : Polynomial ℤ :=
+  Polynomial.X ^ c.val * leafSum c ^ (m.val - 1)
+
+private lemma assemble_weight {l k : ℕ} (a : Parts l) (c : Spine l k)
+    (f : Leaves a c.val) :
+    (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) ^ (∑ v : Vertex a, (assemble a c f v).val) =
+      ∏ i, (Polynomial.X ^ (c.val i).val *
+        ∏ r : Leaf a i, Polynomial.X ^ (f i r).val.val) := by
+  classical
+  rw [← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, Fintype.prod_sigma]
+  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
+  intro i _
+  rw [Fintype.prod_eq_mul_prod_subtype_ne _ (root a i)]
+  apply congrArg₂ (· * ·)
+  · change Polynomial.X ^ (if h : root a i = root a i then c.val i
+      else (f i ⟨root a i,h⟩).val).val = _
+    simp
+  · apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
+    intro r _
+    change Polynomial.X ^ (if h : r.val = root a i then c.val i
+      else (f i ⟨r.val,h⟩).val).val = _
+    simp [r.property]
+
+private lemma coloring_factorization {l k : ℕ} (a : Parts l) :
+    ps (caterpillar a) k = ∑ c : Spine l k, ∏ i, blockWeight (a i) (c.val i) := by
+  classical
+  calc
+    ps (caterpillar a) k =
+        ∑ cf : (c : Spine l k) × Leaves a c.val,
+          ∏ i, (Polynomial.X ^ (cf.1.val i).val *
+            ∏ r : Leaf a i, Polynomial.X ^ (cf.2 i r).val.val) := by
+      symm
+      apply Fintype.sum_equiv (coloringEquiv a).symm
+      intro cf
+      exact (assemble_weight a cf.1 cf.2).symm
+    _ = ∑ c : Spine l k, ∑ f : Leaves a c.val,
+          ∏ i, (Polynomial.X ^ (c.val i).val *
+            ∏ r : Leaf a i, Polynomial.X ^ (f i r).val.val) := by
+      rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
+    _ = _ := by
+      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+      intro c _
+      rw [← Fintype.prod_sum (fun i (f : Leaf a i → {d : Fin k // d ≠ c.val i}) =>
+        Polynomial.X ^ (c.val i).val * ∏ r, Polynomial.X ^ (f r).val.val)]
+      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
+      intro i _
+      rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
+      rw [← Fintype.prod_sum (fun (_ : Leaf a i) (d : {d : Fin k // d ≠ c.val i}) =>
+        (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) ^ d.val.val)]
+      simp [blockWeight, leafSum]
+
+
+private lemma subtype_sum {A : Type*} [Fintype A] (p : A → Prop)
+    (f : A → Polynomial ℤ) :
+    (∑ x : {x // p x}, f x.val) = ∑ x : A, if p x then f x else 0 := by
+  classical
+  rw [← Finset.sum_subtype (Finset.univ.filter p) (by simp), Finset.sum_filter]
+
+private lemma ps_spine_sum {l k : ℕ} (a : Parts l) :
+    ps (caterpillar a) k =
+      ∑ c : Fin l → Fin k, if SpineGood c then ∏ i, blockWeight (a i) (c i) else 0 := by
+  rw [coloring_factorization]
+  exact subtype_sum (SpineGood (l:=l) (k:=k)) (fun c => ∏ i, blockWeight (a i) (c i))
+
+private lemma sum_finfun_succ {A : Type*} [Fintype A] {n : ℕ}
+    (f : (Fin (n+1) → A) → Polynomial ℤ) :
+    ∑ c, f c = ∑ x, ∑ c : Fin n → A, f (Fin.cons x c) := by
+  calc
+    _ = ∑ p : A × (Fin n → A), f (Fin.cons p.1 p.2) :=
+      (Equiv.sum_comp (Fin.consEquiv (fun _ : Fin (n+1) => A)) f).symm
+    _ = _ := Fintype.sum_prod_type _
+
+private noncomputable def fiveSum {k : ℕ} (w : Fin 5 → Fin k → Polynomial ℤ) :=
+  ∑ c₀ : Fin k, ∑ c₁ : Fin k, ∑ c₂ : Fin k, ∑ c₃ : Fin k, ∑ c₄ : Fin k,
+    if c₀ ≠ c₁ ∧ c₁ ≠ c₂ ∧ c₂ ≠ c₃ ∧ c₃ ≠ c₄ then
+      w 0 c₀ * w 1 c₁ * w 2 c₂ * w 3 c₃ * w 4 c₄ else 0
+
+private lemma five_spine_good {k : ℕ} (c : Fin 5 → Fin k) :
+    SpineGood c ↔ c 0 ≠ c 1 ∧ c 1 ≠ c 2 ∧ c 2 ≠ c 3 ∧ c 3 ≠ c 4 := by
+  constructor
+  · intro h
+    exact ⟨h 0 1 rfl,h 1 2 rfl,h 2 3 rfl,h 3 4 rfl⟩
+  · rintro ⟨h₀,h₁,h₂,h₃⟩ i j hij
+    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp_all
+
+set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
+private lemma ps_five {k : ℕ} (a : Parts 5) :
+    ps (caterpillar a) k = fiveSum (k:=k) (fun i c => blockWeight (a i) c) := by
+  rw [ps_spine_sum]
+  simp_rw [five_spine_good]
+  unfold fiveSum
+  rw [sum_finfun_succ]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro c0 _
+  rw [sum_finfun_succ]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro c1 _
+  rw [sum_finfun_succ]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro c2 _
+  rw [sum_finfun_succ]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro c3 _
+  rw [sum_finfun_succ]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro c4 _
+  simp [Fin.prod_univ_succ, mul_assoc]
+  rfl
+
+
+private lemma leafSum_eq {k : ℕ} (c : Fin k) :
+    leafSum c = ∑ d : Fin k, if d ≠ c then Polynomial.X ^ d.val else 0 := by
+  unfold leafSum
+  convert subtype_sum (fun d : Fin k => d ≠ c) (fun d => Polynomial.X ^ d.val) using 1
+  all_goals
+    apply Finset.sum_congr
+    · ext x; simp
+    · intro x _
+      first | rfl | (split_ifs <;> rfl)
+
+set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
+private lemma diagonal_identity (w : Fin 3 → Polynomial ℤ) :
+    fiveSum ![blockWeight 5, w, w, blockWeight 4, blockWeight 3] =
+      fiveSum ![blockWeight 4, w, w, blockWeight 5, blockWeight 3] := by
+  norm_num [fiveSum, Fin.sum_univ_succ, blockWeight, leafSum_eq, Fin.cons]
+  ring
+
+private lemma ps3_equal (j : ℕ+) :
+    ps (caterpillar (alpha j)) 3 = ps (caterpillar (beta j)) 3 := by
+  rw [ps_five, ps_five]
+  have ha : (fun i (c : Fin 3) => blockWeight (alpha j i) c) =
+      ![blockWeight 5, blockWeight j, blockWeight j, blockWeight 4, blockWeight 3] := by
+    funext i c
+    fin_cases i <;> rfl
+  have hb : (fun i (c : Fin 3) => blockWeight (beta j i) c) =
+      ![blockWeight 4, blockWeight j, blockWeight j, blockWeight 5, blockWeight 3] := by
+    funext i c
+    fin_cases i <;> rfl
+  rw [ha,hb]
+  exact diagonal_identity _
+
+private lemma ps2_alpha (j : ℕ+) :
+    ps (caterpillar (alpha j)) 2 =
+      Polynomial.X ^ (j.val+5) + Polynomial.X ^ (j.val+7) := by
+  rw [ps_five]
+  norm_num [fiveSum, Fin.sum_univ_succ, alpha, blockWeight, leafSum_eq, Fin.cons]

+        _ = b i * b j * corr p i j := by
+          rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
+          rw [pair_expect μ hμ i j hij]
+    · simp [hij]
+  calc
+    ∑ x, μ x * weight x ^ 2 =
+        ∑ x, μ x * (∑ i, b i ^ 2 +
+          2 * ∑ i, ∑ j, if i < j then b i * b j * sgn (x i) * sgn (x j) else 0) := by
+      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+      intro x hx
+      rw [weight_sq_expand x]
+    _ = (∑ i, b i ^ 2) * (∑ x, μ x) +
+        2 * ∑ x, μ x * (∑ i, ∑ j,
+          if i < j then b i * b j * sgn (x i) * sgn (x j) else 0) := by
+      simp_rw [mul_add]
+      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
+      rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
+      congr 1
+      · ring
+      · calc
+        _ = ∑ x, 2 * (μ x * (∑ i, ∑ j,
+              if i < j then b i * b j * sgn (x i) * sgn (x j) else 0)) := by
+          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+          intro x hx
+          ring
+        _ = _ := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
+    _ = (∑ i, b i ^ 2) * (∑ x, μ x) +
+        2 * ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ x, μ x *
+          (if i < j then b i * b j * sgn (x i) * sgn (x j) else 0) := by
+      rw [exchange_sum]
+    _ = (∑ i, b i ^ 2) * (∑ x, μ x) +
+        2 * ∑ i, ∑ j, if i < j then b i * b j * corr p i j else 0 := by
+      rw [hinner]
+
+private theorem weight_sq_lower (x : Fin 6 → Bool) : 1 ≤ weight x ^ 2 := by
+  change (1 : ℝ) ≤ (∑ i : Fin 6, ![(1 : ℝ), 1, 1, 1, -1, -2] i *
+    (if x i then 1 else -1)) ^ 2
+  cases h0 : x 0 <;> cases h1 : x 1 <;> cases h2 : x 2 <;>
+    cases h3 : x 3 <;> cases h4 : x 4 <;> cases h5 : x 5 <;>
+    norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_succ, h0, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5]
+
+private theorem p_no_joint : ¬ HasJointDistribution p := by
+  rintro ⟨μ, hμ_nonneg, hμ⟩
+  have hsum : ∑ x, μ x = 1 := sum_mu_one μ hμ
+  have hlower : 1 ≤ ∑ x, μ x * weight x ^ 2 := by
+    rw [← hsum]
+    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
+    intro x hx
+    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (weight_sq_lower x) (hμ_nonneg x)
+    simpa using hm
+  have hexpect := weighted_square_sum μ hμ
+  have heval : ∑ x, μ x * weight x ^ 2 = -1 := by
+    rw [hexpect, hsum]
+    change (∑ i : Fin 6, ![(1 : ℝ), 1, 1, 1, -1, -2] i ^ 2) * 1 +
+      2 * (∑ i : Fin 6, ∑ j : Fin 6, if i < j then
+        ![(1 : ℝ), 1, 1, 1, -1, -2] i * ![(1 : ℝ), 1, 1, 1, -1, -2] j * corr p i j
+        else 0) = -1
+    norm_num [p_corr, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
+  linarith
+
+theorem result : ¬ claim := by
+  intro h
+  exact p_no_joint (h 6 p (by omega) p_family p_ngon p_three)
+
+end
+end D5.S3.Quantum.Contextuality.LeggettGargSixTimeSufficiencyRefutation

+/- GID: D5/S3/Quantum/Fermionic/BcGhostFock
+   generality: I

+   mirror-E: none(waiver:algebraic-ghost-car)
